manifest.notes: Ponziramid(address token_, address owner_, uint256 creatorAllocation_) creates and permanently binds its StoneVault and PonziRewards during construction; their addresses are available through vault(), rewards() and CustodyCreated. They are not separate manifest deployments, and no initialization calls are required. token_ is the launch token and owner_ is the launch's owner, who receives the game's owner Mortar fees and can pause building. creatorAllocation_ is 700000000000000000000000000 minor units (700,000,000 PONZIRAM), the 70% of the fixed supply this launch pays the wallet that funds the game; it is stored once as PonziRewards.INITIAL_FUNDING, the one-time funding gate, and grants no role. StoneVault holds refundable player principal; PonziRewards holds permanent token funding and pays verified player claims. After deployment, the creator funds PonziRewards using an ERC-20 approval followed by fund(amount). No round can start until PonziRewards has held INITIAL_FUNDING once; each new round then requires 1,000,000 uncommitted PONZIRAM. No application receives tokens during construction. The factory supplies the LP, MerkleDistributor and initialization-only pool guard. The native ETH pool fee is 1.25%; the deployer derives the effective opening price from the policy's 10 ETH opening market cap.
